subject.title: feat: add tools.fs.roots — per-agent filesystem roots with access modes

question: Should OpenClaw core accept `tools.fs.roots` as the supported host filesystem allowlist contract after the root-widening bug is fixed?
rationale: This PR creates a new operator-facing filesystem security model and a Plugin SDK helper, which is broader than a normal bug fix and needs maintainer product/security ownership even if the remaining code defect is mechanical.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Fix the workspace-root widening bug, rebase, and continue review toward accepting `tools.fs.roots` as the core host-mode allowlist contract.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep only the media/read-capability pieces needed for current local-media issues and defer the full filesystem-root config API.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Close or pause the PR until maintainers settle filesystem access policy outside this branch.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the workspace-root widening bug, rebase, and continue review toward accepting `tools.fs.roots` as the core host-mode allowlist contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected media/fs-policy paths and current-main history route most strongly to steipete for the product/security decision.
